aadda26a7e26.reason: The code correctly uses `>>` without a preceding space, which is the valid syntax for appending to a file in cmd.exe. Claude checked: in cmd 'echo X>> file' is valid and the entry ends in 'n', so it is not read as a handle number (that only happens for a single digit directly before '>'); the missing space is deliberate, a space would end up in the PATH entry (lesson 258).
aadda26a7e26.title: Incorrect Shell Command Syntax
